name: How do I choose the right grout for my kitchen tile?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right grout for my kitchen tile?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right grout comes down to joint width, stain resistance, and maintenance expectations. For kitchen floors, stain resistance is critical due to frequent cooking spills and cleaning. Standard cementitious grout works well for budget projects but requires periodic sealing to resist grease and wine. High-performance pre-mixed or epoxy grouts offer built-in stain resistance, consistent color, and require no ongoing sealing, making them ideal for heavy kitchen use. Additionally, joint spacing dictates whether you need sanded grout (joints 1/8 inch or wider) or unsanded grout (narrower joints).
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose stain-resistant or epoxy grout for easier cleaning around cooking areas, and select sanded or unsanded grout based on the width of your tile joints.
